title: Modern Times
synopsis: A factory, a paddy wagon, a department store, and a tramp who keeps walking up the road toward the next horizon.

nodes.text: A feeding machine your boss bought from a salesman.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Volunteer.” The story records the instinct as “Reckless” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.

nodes.text: Bolts and spinners and a foreman's whistle.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Keep up.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Your body sucked into a wheel like a small leaf.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Wave on the way.” The story records the instinct as “Calm” and carries it forward.
“Scream” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: A line of dialogue you write on her face with one finger.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Heart.

nodes.text: Two figures on a dusty road and a future that has not been built yet. You whistle. She catches up. The two of you take it from there.
The cafe owner gives you a permanent shift and Gamin a dressing room. The customers wait for the song you have not written yet.
The factory reopens at dawn and you, against your better self, are first in the line. The whistle blows. You smile despite yourself, just barely.
